CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

March 26, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra
  City Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Staff Present:
ERIC D. MARTINEZ

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: March 12, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the March 12, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  901 East Norwood Place, DRB-2023-00223

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 6 ft. high CMU wall located along the
  east side of the property facing South Granada Avenue.
  •  Applicant: Winnie Wong

  1
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed
  project is approved with the following conditions:
  1. The applicant shall revise the topping cap color to be ‘Red’ to match
  the existing CMU block design on the property.
  2. The applicant should study a paint color/finish application for the
  proposed CMU wall, such as a light gray or white color, to elude an
  unfinished appearance while adding an aesthetic quality.
  3. The applicant must re-submit a revised set for City Architect to verify
  and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Vice Chair Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following conditions:
  1. The applicant shall revise the topping cap color to be ‘Red’ to match the
  existing CMU block design on the property.
  2. The applicant should study a paint color/finish application for the proposed
  CMU wall, such as a light gray or white color, to elude an unfinished
  appearance while adding an aesthetic quality.
  3. The applicant must re-submit a revised set for City Architect to verify and
  approve.
  4. The applicant should avoid placing any concrete or hardscape in between the
  proposed wall and the property line.

  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

E. ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:12 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on April 9, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:12 P.M.
  •  The second was by Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
